- One of the classical signs of cardiac tamponade is pulsus paradoxus (option C: A drop in systolic blood pressure of more than 10 mmHg during inspiration).

This does not correspond with the symptoms described in cardiac tamponade.
- The examination found normal breath sounds, which goes against other conditions like pneumothorax, where paradoxical motion of the chest might occur due to lung collapse.
